contract.unknown_callback: Unregistering a callback that is not registered returns false
contract.registry_stability: A failed unregister does not modify the listener registry
contract.listener_preservation: Existing listeners remain registered after an unsuccessful unregister
contract.delivery_preservation: Existing listeners continue receiving events after an unsuccessful unregister
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after an unsuccessful unregister
contract.permission_enforcement: Unregister and emit operations require the events permission
